reviewed_by: Codex: individual visible Penn catalogue-page review
method: Individual public browser navigation and visible Details-table inspection. Selected factual fields transcribed; no full HTML or image capture. robots.txt returned HTTP 404, so automated collection and archival page fetching remained paused.
scope: Verify the existing forty main Montgomery/Penn number mappings. Confirmation is limited to the concordance. Dates, language, dimensions, provenance and identity-like descriptions remain reported observations requiring separate assessment. Evidence fingerprints bind local identity membership, source records, identifiers, appearance links and publication-number claims; they are not hashes of live website content.
